command: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat AGENTS.md CONTEXT.md REPO_MAP.md docs/project.md docs/architecture.md docs/development.md fixtures/ddu-snapshots.json'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import json; from pathlib import Path; x=json.loads(Path(\"fixtures/ddu-snapshots.json\").read_text()); rows=[(o[\"objectId\"], {s[\"date\"]:s.get(\"registeredDduCount\") for s in o[\"snapshots\"]}) for o in x[\"constructionObjects\"]]; known=[s[\"2026-09-30\"] for _,s in rows if s[\"2026-09-30\"] is not None]; pairs=[(i,s[\"2026-09-30\"]-s[\"2026-08-31\"]) for i,s in rows if s[\"2026-09-30\"] is not None and s[\"2026-08-31\"] is not None]; print(json.dumps({\"current_ddu_known_sum\":sum(known),\"available_current_objects\":len(known),\"total_objects\":len(rows),\"comparable_pairs\":pairs,\"comparable_pairs_delta\":sum(d for _,d in pairs),\"unavailable_object_ids\":[i for i,s in rows if s[\"2026-09-30\"] is None]},ensure_ascii=False))'"
